question: Which was the first dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mamluk dynasty**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mamluk dynasty** was the first dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• It was established by **Qutb-ud-din Aibak** in 1206 AD after the death of Muhammad Ghori.
 
• The dynasty is also known as the **Slave dynasty** because many of its rulers were former slaves.
 
• The Mamluk dynasty ruled from 1206 to 1290 AD an
